scripts.format: npm run format:web && uv run --project services/backend --locked ruff format --config services/backend/pyproject.toml services/backend/src services/backend/tests tooling/export_graphql_schema.py
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:web && uv run --project services/backend --locked ruff format --check --config services/backend/pyproject.toml services/backend/src services/backend/tests tooling/export_graphql_schema.py
